urdu: کونسا وزیراعظم یوسف رضا گیلانی کے بعد 25 جون 2012ء کو وزیر اعظم بنا؟
english: Who became the Prime Minister on June 25, 2012, after Yousuf Raza Gilani?
roman_1: Konsa wazir-e-azam Yusuf Raza Gilani ke baad 25 June 2012 ko wazir-e-azam bana?
roman_2: Kaunsa wazir e azam Yusuf Raza Gilani ke baad 25 Jun 2012 ko wazir e azam bana?
roman_3: Kon sa wazir e azam Yusuf Raza Gilani ke baad 25 Jun 2012 ko wazir e azam bana?
